text: Hinglaj Mandir/ Nani Mandir Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Hinglaj Mandir/ Nani Mandir Type: Monument - Temple Province: Balochistan District: Las Bela Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 6th Century BCE - 11th Century CE Description: Hinglaj Mata, also known as Hinglaj Devi, Hingula Devi and Nani Mandir, is a Hindu temple in Hinglaj, a town on the Makran coast in the Lasbela district of Baluchistan, and is the middle of the Hingol National Park. Latitude: 25.513889000 Longitude: 65.515278000 Ownership: Private Legal Status: Not Protected Title of Publication: Historic temples in Pakistan: A call to conscience Published In: nternational Journal of Environmental Studies, Vol. 73, No.4 Year of Publication: 2016 Bibliography/Reference: Misra, M.
